history_semantics: History iteration k+1 evaluates checkpoint k before its next Adam update; final checkpoint has no subsequent history loss.
display_status_field: finite_window_pass (有限窗口通过); archived stable remains for traceability
scientific_findings: Actual Adam updates changed body kernel/growth/seed and local acquisition/inheritance parameters.
Two Orbium-derived references remain near Orbium; random starts yield bands, loops and saturated patches, often transient.
Five V1 representatives continued to life 2112: all retained mass, three became near stationary; only the Orbium-like branch retained strong activity.
V2 restarted four random-origin genotypes and trained through 256 steps: two checkpoints passed the 1088-step screen; one branch later died. Saturated patterns remain.
Uniform simultaneous cue/outcome learning is the existing conditional integrator; novelty and adaptive advantage have not been established.
limitations: Finite active-screen stable flags do not establish health, species or fitness.
V2 retained checkpoints descend from V1, not independent new initial populations.
Centered GIFs remove translational motion; raw periodic arrays preserve it.
Different curriculum horizons/objectives make raw losses across stages incomparable.
Kernel arrays and decoded growth parameters are necessary; default LeniaConfig does not reconstruct these rules.
